```{=html}
<!-- Navbar -->
{{< include _navbar.html >}}

<!-- Page content -->
<div class="auth-page">
  <div class="auth-card" style="max-width: 520px; text-align: center;">
    <img src="assets/logo.png" alt="AAIC Logo" class="auth-logo">
    <h2 style="color: #006C93;">Welcome, Guest</h2>
    <p style="color: #58595B; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.7; margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem 0;">
      Feel free to explore our modules, but please note that your progress will not be saved.
    </p>
    <a href="modules.html" class="role-btn role-btn-primary" style="display: inline-flex; padding: 1rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 50px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem;">
      Explore Modules
    </a>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// If the user is not a guest and not logged in, redirect to choose-role
(function() {
  var isGuest = sessionStorage.getItem('aaic_guest') === 'true';

  function checkAccess() {
    if (typeof _supabase === 'undefined' || !_supabase) {
      // Supabase not loaded yet -- if they're a guest, that's fine
      if (isGuest) return;
      setTimeout(checkAccess, 200);
      return;
    }
    _supabase.auth.getSession().then(function(result) {
      var session = result.data.session;
      if (!session && !isGuest) {
        window.location.href = 'choose-role.html';
      }
    });
  }
  checkAccess();
})();
</script>
```
